validated_behavior: A complex image-grounded action list is produced in one task call plus one advanced-planner call when providers respond normally.
Actions sharing a destination use compact free-space placement and re-observe occupancy after every release.
Fast placement releases on measured destination contact and then uses physical support/stability evaluation.
Visual uncertainty or checker outage cannot replay a physically completed released action.
A hard independent stage cannot discard or block later independent stages solely because of a global recovery count.
Skipped object labels survive replanning and are filtered from later plans in the same task list.
A fixed fixture is rejected by physical manipulability rather than configured asset names.
remaining_gap: The scene does not contain a container/support arrangement reachable for every loose part with the current grasp. Full-table completion needs a larger reachable bin, object regrasp/staging for the shaft, and a more reliable bolt localization/placement attempt.
